name: Ball Bounce Dashed
description: A centered ball bounces while an animated dashed line scrolls beneath it

variations.name: default
variations.description: Ball stays centered and bounces in place while a dashed ground line scrolls underneath, creating the illusion of motion

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Color of the dashed ground line

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Width of the dashed line stroke
